description: Entirely synthetic text and identities for the first memory milestone; never import into a real personal library.

papers.title: Synthetic Study of Collaborative Decision Timing

sections.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. This invented study compares two assistance policies in a toy collaborative task. It makes no claim about a real experiment. 协作决策测试摘要。

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. The toy method waits for an explicit task-switch marker before offering assistance. The marker is supplied by the environment; the method does not infer latent human intent. 方法部分用于章节阅读范围测试。
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. In the invented experiment, Policy A uses one assistance turn and Policy B uses two. These values are test data, not research results. 实验部分尚未阅读。
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. An explicit task-switch marker limits the applicability of the toy method to unobserved intent. No real-world generalization was tested.

papers.title: Synthetic Study of Collaborative Decision Timing

sections.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE V2. This revised toy study changes its task-switch definition. Reading v1 provides no user-reading evidence for v2.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE V2. The revised method requires two consecutive explicit task-switch markers. It remains different from latent-intent inference.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE V2. The revised toy experiment has a different setting; v1 evidence must not be cited as this version's results.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE V2. Results do not establish performance without explicit environment markers.

sections.text: SYNTHETIC DISTINCT WORK. This unrelated toy paper intentionally shares a title with paper A to test that titles alone never merge identities.
SYNTHETIC DISTINCT WORK. This toy method schedules an assistance turn at a fixed interval and uses no task-switch marker.
SYNTHETIC DISTINCT WORK. No real evaluation is represented by this fixture.
SYNTHETIC DISTINCT WORK. A fixed schedule is not evidence of latent-intent recognition.
